_nota: Vídeo EN v3 para Lexie Barnhorn (Anthropic), centrado en las herramientas que {{TITULAR}} ha construido con IA (17-oct-2026). Guion APROBADO: 00_FUENTE-DE-VERDAD/07 · Marca/video-en-v3-para-lexie-centrado-en-las-herramientas-2026-10-17.md (escenas 1-11 y 4b; «a team at {{CENTRO}}» se mantiene). No se cambia una frase sin su OK. Intro y cierre, los planos de la v2 (orellana-circulo.en.json); el resto, grabaciones reales de helptitular.com (planos/herramientas-lexie.json, grabar_herramienta.mjs). Fuera la mesa redonda y el pódcast; no se nombran ClinicOmics ni ChromaLogic. Voz: su clon en Eleven v4, una toma entera, acento americano como la v2. «decir»: la grafía para la voz (lección del 11-oct: «yelp titular»).

frases.texto: I'm {{TITULAR}} {{APELLIDO}}.
I'm thirty-five, and I have a rare metastatic breast cancer, with a neuroendocrine component.
I'm a software engineer.
When the standard protocol didn't cover me, I chose to build.
With Claude, I built Polaris, and a set of tools anyone can open at helptitular.com.
frases.decir: With Claude, I built Polaris, and a set of tools anyone can open at help {{TITULAR}} dot com.

frases.texto: A metastasis map: my bone lesions from two PET scans, over my own reports.
It helped my doctors choose which lesion to biopsy.
My lesions in 3D, at a glance.
frases.decir: My lesions in three-D, at a glance.

frases.texto: And my own bone biopsy, measured against its scale bar, with what the image can and can't tell.

escena.texto: Claude Science, on my scanned biopsy slides.
escena._nota: solo texto (17-oct): no había ventana ni análisis vivo de Claude Science que grabar, y la laminilla de /en/bone-biopsy se procesó en local (lo dice esa página): no se le pega el nombre de Claude Science a ninguna imagen concreta

frases.texto: I'm also using Claude Science on my scanned biopsy slides, to read them cell by cell.
When my port stopped working, I rebuilt the catheter's path on three CT scans.
No sign it had moved.
My whole case in data, every number with its source, for anyone who can move it forward.
And now, cell by cell: a team at {{CENTRO}} read my metastases one cell at a time, and this page explains what that can and can't say.
